title: Junior Data Analyst
description:
Join our finance analytics team to measure how small businesses use Nimbus.

You will:
- Write SQL to answer product questions
- Build and maintain dashboards in Power BI or Looker
- Present findings in our weekly metrics review

Requirements:
- Solid SQL
- Experience with a BI tool such as Power BI or Looker
- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills
- Fluent written English
- Nice to have: Python for analysis

Location: fully remote. We hire anywhere in Europe, including countries outside the EU, as long as you work within CET plus or minus two hours.

How to apply: apply through our careers portal and answer two short questions.

questions: Why do you want to work at Nimbus Ledger?
Describe a time you automated or sped up a report.

team: You'll join a four-person finance analytics team that reports to the Head of Product Analytics and works with product managers on the invoicing and payments squads.
benefits: Fully remote with a EUR 1,000 home-office budget
interview_process: Final chat with the Head of Product Analytics

title: Data Analyst (Junior)

Help clinics reduce missed appointments by analysing scheduling data.

- SQL and Excel
- Tableau or Power BI

How to apply: through our careers portal.
team: You'll work in the clinic insights team alongside two analysts and a data engineer.

title: Junior BI Analyst
description:
Build reporting for our warehouse operations team.

- SQL and Power BI

This is a hybrid role: three days a week in our Berlin office. Relocation support is not available.

How to apply: through our careers portal.

questions: Which warehouse metric would you track first?

team: You'll support the warehouse operations team in Berlin.

title: Junior Data Analyst
description:
Work with a senior consultant to build dashboards for retail and non-profit clients.

Requirements:
- SQL for cleaning and joining data
- Dashboards in Tableau or Power BI
- Comfortable presenting to clients in English
- Nice to have: experience with non-profit or retail data

Location: remote from any country, on a contractor agreement.

How to apply: through our careers portal. Include one dashboard you are proud of.

questions: Which dashboard are you proudest of, and why?

team: You'll pair with a senior consultant on every project, typically two client projects at a time.
interview_process: Walk us through a dashboard you built (30 minutes)

title: Mobility Data Analyst (Junior)

- Clear reporting for non-technical audiences
- Nice to have: maps or geospatial analysis
- Serbian, Croatian, Bosnian or Macedonian is a plus

Location: remote from Serbia, Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro or North Macedonia, or from our Belgrade office.

How to apply: through our careers portal.

questions: Tell us about a dataset you explored with Python.

team: You'll join the four-person data team that plans vehicle placement and prepares monthly reports for city partners.
interview_process: Interview with the team and an operations manager
